You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 5cfacab3dd59b151a5dc265b7f105c3d59ea7b08 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: tomas-muller <muller@unitime.org>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2017 15:22:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Instructor Detail: Class Assignments

- fixed an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException thrown when the instructor is assigned to one or more classes, but there is no committed timetable yet
- the problem has been introduced by a recent change (commit cef4170, added Responsibility column)
- this fixes issue #27
---
 .../org/unitime/timetable/action/InstructorDetailAction.java    | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/action/InstructorDetailAction.java b/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/action/InstructorDetailAction.java
index 49fbecdf3..54ecbf884 100644
--- a/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/action/InstructorDetailAction.java
+++ b/JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/action/InstructorDetailAction.java
@@ -253,7 +253,7 @@ public class InstructorDetailAction extends PreferencesAction {
 		    					null,
 		    					new String[] {MSG.columnClass(), MSG.columnInstructorCheckConflicts(), MSG.columnInstructorShare(), MSG.columnTeachingResponsibility(),
 		    							MSG.columnLimit(), MSG.columnManager()},
-		    					new String[] {"left", "left","left", "left", "left"},
+		    					new String[] {"left", "left","left", "left", "left", "left"},
 		    					null )
 			    	);
 			    
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` due to a mismatch in the number of columns defined in the array for the table header and the alignment array. Specifically, the addition of a new column (Responsibility) in a recent change (commit cef4170) was not reflected in the corresponding alignment array, which led to an attempt to access an index that did not exist in the alignment array when the instructor was assigned to classes without a committed timetable. This resulted in the exception being thrown. The patch fixed this by adding an additional entry to the alignment array to match the new column count.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` due to a mismatch in the number of columns defined in the array for the table header and the alignment array. Specifically, the addition of a new column (Responsibility) in a recent change (commit cef4170) was not reflected in the corresponding alignment array, which led to an attempt to access an index that did not exist in the alignment array when the instructor was assigned to classes without a committed timetable. This resulted in the exception being thrown. The patch fixed this by adding an additional entry to the alignment array to match the new column count.
